summary: Round 2, improved and corrected, plus family AE. Every matchable effect shows its level 2, and every family was read twice by a pair reviewer: once for defects and once for how to make each effect more fun, challenging and rewarding. 1,997 live questions, 278 retired in place. Family AE (449 new) is the card index: cards everyone knows, from tickets and tarot to board games, chess pieces and a village, kept by name and idea and given an effect for the grid; an option beginning "Renames Qnnnn" offers that existing effect the name, and a name already taken carries v2. Family AB is 19 effects built around aiming at marks; family AC asks the level 2 of each effect you already ruled on (its (d) keeps the effect with no level 2); family AD is 29 new effects the reviewer proposed. Your rulings are applied: fame is not spendable; a property's level 2 is unlocked by its own match unless an effect says otherwise; a bonus with no line goes to special; a fake is a ghost card that leaves the deck when its show ends; a token is any card and its effect decides whether it stays; a step is flat points tuned per effect; every card keeps a suit and a rank.
